At CNH, you’ll not only find the resources to succeed today—you’ll find the foundation to grow a career and build a future.

The company combines cloud technology, data, and artificial intelligence to simplify complex experiences and help the industry work more efficiently. About The Role CCC is seeking a Lead Backend Engineer to join the DPS Core & Data Engine Squad. In this role, you will help modernize the system-of-record platform behind internal DPS and external IES claims management experiences. The platform supports millions of transactions and billions of dollars in claims, making performance, data integrity, and availability essential. You will bring technical leadership to database modernization, performance optimization, and strategic refactoring of complex systems. Working closely with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to improve the architecture while preserving the stability of business-critical workflows. This position is suited to an engineer who can balance hands-on delivery with sound technical judgment, communicate trade-offs clearly, and guide incremental change across a large, established platform. Qualifications Extensive professional experience building and supporting backend software in production environments. Strong expertise in relational databases, SQL, query analysis, and database performance optimization. Experience refactoring complex stored procedures and transitioning business logic into maintainable application services. Proficiency with a modern backend programming language and experience designing reliable, scalable services. Understanding of data modeling, transactional systems, service integration, and approaches to protecting data integrity. Experience planning and executing incremental migrations in systems that require high availability and careful backward compatibility. Ability to investigate complex performance issues using metrics, logs, traces, query plans, and other diagnostic tools. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to varied audiences. Experience providing technical direction, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, and promoting maintainable engineering practices. Commitment to quality, operational readiness, security, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Lead backend engineering work to modernize core data and claims processing capabilities. Analyze stored procedures, database workloads, and service behavior to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Refactor legacy logic into well-defined, testable services while preserving business rules and transaction accuracy. Design safe migration patterns, including phased rollouts, compatibility planning, validation, and recovery strategies. Improve SQL performance and system efficiency through measurement, tuning, and evidence-based engineering decisions. Develop and maintain backend components that support dependable internal and external claims experiences. Partner with product, architecture, quality, and operations teams to clarify requirements and deliver sustainable solutions. Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, and knowledge sharing. Monitor production outcomes and use operational feedback to guide further optimization and modernization. Benefits The expected salary range for this position is $119,030.52 to $165,000.00.
